fact: On 30 July 2025 the AI Task Force met at the CNCCI, where a pilot AI Hub is to be installed in the building (to be renovated and equipped), with a larger hub planned later at VITIB Grand-Bassam.
title: Mercredi 30 Juillet 2025: Séance de travail de la TASK FORCE IA au Centre National de Calcul de Côte d’Ivoire (CNCCI)
publisher: Centre National de Calcul de Côte d'Ivoire
